cases.summary: The client reported that the video had not been delivered overnight or after a two-hour commitment. The agent characterized the video as delayed and restated the reported two-hour promise, but the transcript does not establish when that commitment began or elapsed.
cases.agent_quote: You expected a perfect cut days ago and instead got delays and questions that felt insulting to your time.…You expected that if I said “give me 2 hours and I’ll do X,” then in a crisis I’d just shut up and *do it*, not start talking about limitations.
cases.client_quote: I can't believe you would do this install, and you have not delivered all night.…you're going to send the perfect video that you should have sent 5 fucking days ago and last night,… If I had 2 hours, you would do.
